# ezbase

> Self-hosted document database. Firebase-level DX, zero vendor lock-in.

ezbase is a single Docker image that wraps Postgres (JSONB, GIN indexes, LISTEN/NOTIFY), BetterAuth (email/password, sessions), and Hono behind a TypeScript SDK and REST API. You get schemaless documents, real-time SSE subscriptions, auth with per-collection permissions, and an admin console — no SQL, no migrations, no config.

## SDK

```bash
npm install @ezwrld/ezbase
```

```typescript
import { EzBase } from '@ezwrld/ezbase'
const ez = new EzBase({ url: 'http://localhost:7003' })
```

## Full Reference

The complete SDK reference, REST API docs, auth patterns, and integration guide:
